notes: button collision geometry + joint params from OGBench button_inner.xml (frame uprighted); collision contact uses the shared generated-geometry defaults; visual meshes replaced by primitives; UR5e swapped for the repo Panda. The scene is neutral red; the init is dealt per reset seed as a board that a known 10 to 20 press set turns all red, which is the goal. The 24-seed scripted acceptance measured up to 162 control steps/press and 2921 per full solve. A human teleop press (approach/close/down/up, waypoints 0..3) measured 87 control steps; 20 x 87 x 1.5 = 2610, rounded up to 3000, then raised to the previous-budget floor max_len=8000 so the sim limit does not bind before the 10800 s wall clock.
